mode.description: How strict to be about comments. keep and remove apply on top.
enumDescriptions: Keep every comment unless remove names its category.
Remove comments that restate the code, disabled code, banners, change notes and signature-only docs.
Also remove TODOs and comments that only summarise what code does.

level.deprecationMessage: Use "mode" instead: all is off, value-add is standard, necessary is strict.

keep.description: Categories to keep whatever the mode.

remove.description: Categories to remove whatever the mode.

behaviour.description: How your team judges its comments, in plain English. Jev weighs it when it picks each comment's category.

threshold.description: How sure Jev must be (0 to 1) before a comment is flagged.

ignore.description: Globs to skip, relative to this file, on top of .gitignore.

fixThreshold.description: Minimum removal probability for an automatic fix or PR suggestion. Uses the higher of this value and threshold. Fixes require a validated JS/TS/JSX/TSX edit.
